recommended_phase21_experiment: Huber + within-dataset pairwise ranking B0 smoke (R2), no target scaling in first ranking smoke
rationale: KonIQ target scaling can improve target variance, but prior weighted smoke collapsed after contribution math was fixed and official agreement shows ranking/teacher-following issues remain. Within-dataset ranking avoids cross-dataset scale mismatch and tests ranking signal with lower label-policy risk than combining scaling plus ranking.
required_code_before_smoke: Add custom train_step or custom loss wrapper that receives dataset ids.
Emit dataset id from tf.data for training only; keep eval/predict path unchanged.
Start with within-dataset pairwise logistic rank loss, margin 0.05, lambda_rank 0.10.
Keep B1/B2 paused until ranking smoke beats W5-lite and directionally approaches Phase 16 unweighted B0.
